Module CW2013
Package SnakeGame.Models

Class ItemsModel

java.lang.Object
SnakeGame.Models.Entity
SnakeGame.Models.ItemsModel
public class ItemsModel extends Entity
The ItemsModel class represents items in the SnakeGame, such as food and obstacles. It provides methods to generate random items, get their images, and manage their positions and status.
